_comment: Domains used to cluster the directory. Edit freely (names and descriptions); subdomains are discovered from the emails. Re-run `kb fold` after changing domains.

domains.Infrastructure: servers, VMs, storage, backup, operating systems, virtualization, datacenter
domains.Network: network flows and firewall rules, VPN, DNS, load balancers, IP addressing, connectivity
domains.Security: Active Directory accounts and groups, access rights, credentials, certificates, security validations, vulnerabilities
domains.Portal & Web: customer and partner portals, websites, CMS, web front ends, mobile app back-office
domains.Applications: business applications (billing, CRM, OSS/BSS, middleware): installation, configuration, incidents
domains.Data & Databases: databases, data extracts and loads, reporting, BI
domains.DevOps & Release: deployments to environments, releases / MEP, CI/CD, change approval (CAB)
domains.Workplace & IT support: laptops, mailboxes, licences, software on workstations, helpdesk
domains.Procurement & Admin: purchase requests and orders, contracts, vendor onboarding, budget, invoices
